verdict.rationale: stagewise is described as an open-source agentic IDE distributed as a downloadable desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux. It can run fully on your own infrastructure: local models via Ollama, LM Studio or OpenAI-compatible endpoints with "zero external API calls," and BYOK for every provider so that no requests go through the managed service. The enterprise tier also offers optional self-hosting of the stagewise Cloud. Missing for 10: self-hosting of the cloud/backend appears limited to the Enterprise tier with no deployment documentation, there is no self-hosting setup guide, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of a fully self-hosted deployment.
